snippet.title: Lavatro Kickstarter trailer
snippet.description:
Lavatro is a roguelite game centered around doing laundry. Your goal is to organize clothes efficiently to optimize the washing process. Combine clothes in endless ways, discover money hidden in garments that allows you to purchase new abilities, and improve your laundry skills.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4157200/Lavatro

Support on Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/stuckpixel/lavatro-the-roguelite-cloth-builder-0
